doc: A crop (design/planner.md, Crops), as a config entry: how its plants grow, how far apart, how tall, their colours, and how much the wind moves them.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: How its plants grow: grain (stalks with heads), a tall stalk (maize, sunflowers), a leafy head (cabbage, lettuce), root tops (carrots, potatoes), gourds on the ground (pumpkins), a pole vine (beans), a trellis vine (grapes), or flowering bushes (lavender).

fields.name: spacing
fields.doc: Metres between plants along a row.

fields.name: fruit_color
fields.doc: What it bears: heads, cobs, gourds, bunches, roots' shoulders.

fields.name: ripe_color
fields.doc: The colour ripe grain or leaves turn.

fields.name: fruit_size
fields.doc: How big what it bears is, metres.

fields.name: sway
fields.doc: How much the wind moves it, 0 to 1.
